Daily Devotional

June 17

7 Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding. (Proverbs 4:7 KJV)

There are many times in the Word of God, that wisdom and understanding are mentioned together in the same verse. This is because the two are necessary for us to be able to know the meaning of the Scriptures, as understanding the Scriptures must come as we read it, and then we must have the wisdom to be able to put the knowledge of the Scriptures into practice. Both these things are necessary for us to be able to properly interpret the Scriptures, and be able to remember them so the devil won’t be able to steal the Word from us (Matthew 13:19).

God has been so very kind to us, by sending the Holy Spirit to live in us (Acts 2:4), so that the Holy Spirit can help us understand the Word and give us the wisdom to put it into practice (John 14:26). Just mentally knowing the Word is not enough, as it must be understood at the heart level, before it will change our hearts, and make us sensitive to God. Every born again believer, who is baptized in the Holy Ghost, has the Holy Spirit living within them (John 14:16-17), and if you will study and ponder the Word of God on a regular and consistent basis, the Holy Spirit will enable you to understand all that God is and has for us. Wow, how grateful we should be to our Father for His sending us the Holy Spirit.
